strings: After the worried reports of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates, r_c0 comes to check on m_c with a package of herbs. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} been staring blankly at one spot of the den for hours now.
m_c's head spins and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} like every blink, the world around {PRONOUN/m_c/object} speeds away - leaving {PRONOUN/m_c/object} disoriented and lost.
Between one blink and the next, m_c feels like {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} soul has jumped and the world is somewhat underwater.
m_c's denmates carefully make sure that there's nothing too out of place for when {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} mind comes back to {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
